content:
Reflections from my desk – Still Looking, Still Learning

Last week, I shared my love of food and cooking. This week, another passion of mine: driving.

There's something about a winding country road, a few good bends and the pleasure of driving that always puts a smile on my face.

And it got me thinking. After nearly 37 years with one employer, perhaps I should try advertising myself as a second-hand car! 😂

So, something a little different from my usual reflections this week...

FOR SALE (well, available for employment!)

Model: GG71 – Business Management Edition

Year first registered: 1989

Previous owners: One. Nearly 37 years of continuous service.

Service history: Extensive. Progressed through operations, communications, business management, organisational improvement and transformation.

Engine: Powered by curiosity, practical thinking and a willingness to challenge assumptions. Comfortable with ambiguity, understanding problems and finding practical ways forward.

Handling: Confident working with leaders, colleagues and specialist teams. Particularly good at balancing competing priorities, bringing different perspectives together and helping people make informed decisions.

Load capacity: Experience supporting functions of 250–500 colleagues, with wider responsibilities across an organisation of c.35,000. Equally interested in smaller teams and organisations. Not every journey requires a large vehicle!

Performance: Established COO functions, improved operating models and simplified governance. Organisational redesigns delivered c.£3m in combined annual savings, with improvements in planning, accountability and decision-making.

Passenger comfort: People-focused, with a commitment to coaching, mentoring and developing colleagues. Five former team members progressed into more senior roles.

Optional extras: Executive Coaching Diploma, Lean Six Sigma and Agile qualifications. Also comes with a sense of humour and a willingness to ask awkward questions!

Upgrades: Regularly maintained through learning and professional development. Comfortable exploring emerging technologies, AI and new ways of working. No obsolete software here!

Current condition: Experienced, adaptable, recently refreshed and ready for a new challenge.

Availability: Immediate. Looking for the next opportunity in business management.

Now, jokes aside, I'm still looking for my next role. I've spent recent months reflecting on my experience, listening to feedback and becoming clearer about where I can make a valuable contribution.

If you're aware of an opportunity where my experience might be useful, I'd really appreciate you getting in touch or pointing me in the right direction.

And if we've worked together and youve appreciated the handling, reliability or performance over the years, a LinkedIn recommendation or endorsement would be very welcome too!

One previous employer. Plenty of experience. Still learning. And definitely plenty of miles left to travel.
